publicContract.result: one bounded semantic summary delta with optional selected-agent detail feed
publicContract.selection: selected or collapsed state is explicit; selection identity rejects late prior-selection results

implementation.normalization: owned App Server/workflow/delegation/message observations with strict attribution and semantic statuses
implementation.privacy: reasoning and prompt/environment fields excluded; credentials and unnecessary paths redacted; detail and error text bounded before persistence
implementation.authority: item/completed and turn/completed are authoritative; deltas are advisory and coalesced at 50ms or 4096 bytes
implementation.durability: PostgreSQL summaries, monotonic identity cursor, exact replay deduplication, conflicting replay no-write, snapshot-listen-requery wait, restart reconstruction
implementation.retention: 100 selected-agent detail rows at 4096 bytes each with truncation metadata; 500 summary rows with truncation metadata
implementation.uiHandoff: compact workflow-step-agent hierarchy, concise progress labels, human-readable state/error text, host-owned appearance, and no backend colors/layout/framework schema
implementation.mechanism: ordinary indexed PostgreSQL; no cache, stream broker, or per-token durable write path

validation.processLint: CAS-08 clean; target remains nonzero only for pre-existing CAS-06 delegation step error outside lease

handoff.CAS-09: Expose snapshot and wait directly as one-call cursor tools; retain compact unchanged results and selected-feed filtering.
handoff.CAS-10: Render workflows -> steps -> agents from semantic status/state/progress fields; read theme/color scheme from the host and keep collapsed/selected feed generation identity.
handoff.CAS-12: Use durable cursor/requery, idempotent replay, reconnect replacement, daemon reconstruction, and zero-resource cleanup as integration contracts.

independence: Worker evidence only; fresh independent verification and judgment remain required.
